items.title: Penumbra receives US FDA clearance for Lightning CAVT technology for the treatment of DVT
items.summary: Penumbra has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted clearance for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) to its Lightning computer assisted vacuum thrombectomy (CAVT) technology. The indication is supported by results from the BOLT-DVT investigational device exemption (IDE) trial.

items.title: Haemonetics announces US FDA approval of PerQseal Elite vascular closure system
items.summary: Haemonetics has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of the PerQseal Elite vascular closure system for large-bore arterial procedures.

items.title: US FDA approves Gore Viabahn VBX balloon-expandable endoprosthesis for expanded use in FEVAR and BEVAR
items.summary: Gore today announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of an expanded indication for the company’s Viabahn VBX balloon-expandable endoprosthesis (VBX stent graft) for use in fenestrated and branched endovascular aneurysm repair (FEVAR and BEVAR).

items.title: Endovascular Engineering receives two US FDA 510(k) clearances for PE thrombectomy devices
items.summary: Endovascular Engineering (E2) recently announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted 510(k) clearance for both the Hēlo thrombectomy system and Hēlo Return, a blood return system.

items.title: STRIKE-PE interim analysis indicates “potential for reduced burden of post-PE syndrome after treatment with CAVT”
items.summary: Investigators presented a new interim analysis of 1,000 prospective patients from the STRIKE-PE trial, looking at one-year functional outcomes and quality of life for pulmonary embolism (PE) patients after computer-assisted vacuum thrombectomy (CAVT), demonstrating that functional status and capacity were sustained…

items.title: Laguna thrombectomy system meets primary endpoints in pivotal pulmonary embolism study
items.summary: Innova Vascular has announced positive results from the pivotal TRUST study, which evaluated the Laguna thrombectomy system for the treatment of pulmonary embolism (PE). The data were presented at the Vascular InterVentional Advances (VIVA) conference (4–7 October, Las Vegas, USA).

items.title: Surmodics adds ultra-thin polymer surface modification technology to its haemocompatible portfolio
items.summary: Surmodics has announced that it has acquired the business of Alta Biomed, a medical device coating and testing services company specialising in surface technologies for vascular and other medical devices.

items.title: STORM-PE shows “significant correlation” between wearable-captured activity and walk test
items.summary: A subset analysis of the landmark STORM-PE randomised controlled trial (RCT) demonstrated a significant correlation between real-world, daily step-based activity as captured on a consumer wearable device and patient performance in the clinical six-minute walk test.

items.title: Shape Memory Medical receives ANVISA market authorisation for Impede embolisation plug family in Brazil
items.summary: Shape Memory Medical has announced that Brazil’s national health surveillance agency, ANVISA (Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária), has granted authorization for the Impede embolisation plug, the Impede-FX embolisation plug, and the Impede-FX RapidFill.

items.title: ESVS 2026 live blog
Changes put forward for vascular surgery services by South Cumbrian health board
items.summary: NHS Lancashire and South Cumbria Integrated Care Board has put forward a proposal to create a single specialist centre for planned and emergency inpatient vascular surgery. Reported by Cumbria Crack on 7 October 2026; detail taken from the Google Alert snippet as the site blocks automated fetches.

items.summary: Among patients with femoropopliteal artery disease and no tissue loss, angioplasty with the MagicTouch PTA sirolimus-coated balloon (Concept Medical) was associated with a lower one-year rate of target-lesion revascularisation (TLR) compared with uncoated balloon angioplasty in a secondary analysis of the SirPAD…

items.title: CX co-chair receives VIVA 2026 LIVE Award
items.summary: Charing Cross (CX) Symposium co-chair Andrew Holden (Auckland City Hospital, Auckland, New Zealand) received the VIVA Foundation’s 2026 LIVE Award yesterday morning.

items.title: Endologix rebrands as Rhevera Medical
items.summary: Endologix Holdings has announced Rhevera Medical as its new corporate brand—an updated identity that reflects the company’s broader commitment to partnering with physicians who treat complex vascular disease, and supporting patients whose lives, mobility and independence depend on the company’s technologies, as stated…

items.summary: The Selution sustained limus release (SLR) Sustane drug-eluting balloon (DEB; MedAlliance/Cordis) has achieved patency results (90.3%) in line with best-in-class paclitaxel devices and the highest reported Kaplan-Meier (KM) rate in a superficial femoral artery (SFA) investigational device exemption (IDE) trial to…

items.title: AMA assigns new CPT codes for renal denervation
items.summary: The American Medical Association (AMA) has approved two new category I current procedural terminology (CPT) codes describing renal denervation.

items.title: First patient enrolled in Gore Excluder IBE Plus stent graft pivotal study
items.summary: Gore announced today the first patient enrolment in the IBE Plus pivotal study, a clinical trial evaluating the investigational Gore Excluder iliac branch endoprosthesis (IBE) Plus stent graft for the treatment of aortoiliac and common iliac artery aneurysms.

items.title: Inquis Medical launches “first” thrombectomy catheter with full 360-degree directional aspiration for PE
items.summary: Inquis Medical has announced the US commercial launch of its latest Aventus catheter, which is designed to provide physicians with 360-degree sweeping directional aspiration for clot removal within the vasculature.

items.title: Medtronic receives US FDA Breakthrough Device designation for IN.PACT BTK drug-coated balloon
items.summary: Medtronic has received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Breakthrough Device designation for its IN.PACT below-the-knee (BTK) drug-coated balloon.

items.title: “Huge variation in practice”: Early insights from the European Venous Registry
items.summary: The European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) European Venous Registry (EVeR) is set to elucidate clinical practice patterns for the management of deep venous disease, with the aim of improving long-term patient outcomes.

items.title: iPerf concludes clinical trial of novel dual-lumen femoral arterial cannula for cardiopulmonary support
items.summary: iPerf has announced the conclusion of its first clinical trial evaluating its dual-lumen femoral arterial cannula for cardiopulmonary support.

items.title: SWEDEPAD 2 sparks guideline update for asymptomatic PAD and intermittent claudication
items.summary: The European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) has incorporated new evidence, predominantly from SWEDEPAD 2, into updated recommendations on the management of asymptomatic peripheral arterial disease (PAD) and intermittent claudication.

items.title: UK Government backs major vascular care reforms—now it must turn words into action, says Circulation Foundation
items.summary: The Circulation Foundation—the UK’s leading vascular charity—is calling on the UK Government to move swiftly from agreement to action following a landmark Westminster Hall debate on vascular health, in which members of parliament (MPs) united behind the need for urgent reform of vascular services.
